stories.headline: Kate Bishop Is Back: Hailee Steinfeld Gets Her Doomsday Chair
stories.blurb: Marvel just confirmed Hailee Steinfeld returns as Kate Bishop in Avengers: Doomsday. The reveal came in a sneaky clip from her Hexed press tour, where a director's chair with her name and a green bow was "delivered" to the wrong movie. Doomsday hits theaters December 18, so the Hawkeye apprentice is officially headed for the big leagues.
stories.quip: Somewhere Clint Barton is pretending he isn't proud. He is.

stories.headline: The Next Fallout Game Is About Finding Cats. We're So In.
stories.blurb: Bethesda's official Fallout account confirmed A Wasteland Full of Cats, a Fallout-inspired hidden object game from Devcats Games, made in partnership with the rescue group Dallas Pets Alive. The vault's cats escape into the Wasteland and you have to find them all across 14 locations and 33 rooms. Yes, there is a final boss fight against Radroaches.
stories.quip: War never changes. Cats never come when called.

stories.headline: IShowSpeed Finally Won a Horse Race. Well, Sort Of.
stories.blurb: A racehorse named I Show Speed won a 1,000-metre race at Bong Bong racecourse in Australia on November 20, finishing 1.3 lengths ahead of the pack. It's the four-year-old's third career win, and his stable says he was born premature and fought his way to the track. The internet loved it, since the real IShowSpeed famously lost a sprint to a racehorse back in April.
stories.quip: If you can't beat the horse, become the horse.

stories.headline: Miley Got Married, and a Flaming Lip Did the Honors
stories.blurb: Miley Cyrus married Liily drummer Maxx Morando on November 21 at a private home in Palm Springs. The ceremony was officiated by her longtime friend and collaborator Wayne Coyne of the Flaming Lips. A month ago she debuted "Let's Get Married" live at the Hollywood Bowl with Maxx onstage, so she basically announced it in song first.
stories.quip: No inflatable orbs at the wedding, which is honestly the most restrained Wayne Coyne has ever been.

stories.headline: Xiaolin Showdown Is Streaming Again After 23 Years
stories.blurb: Kids' WB! classic Xiaolin Showdown is coming to Tubi for free starting December 1, its first time streaming in 23 years. Wacky Races, MAD and Duck Dodgers join the lineup too. Grab the Shen Gong Wu and clear your Saturday morning.
stories.quip: Xiaolin Showdown! Gong Yi Tanpai! Okay, now go make cereal.

stories.headline: Kirby Can Ride a Bomb Now, and Other Great News
stories.blurb: Nintendo's winter catalogue in Japan spilled new details on Kirby and the World Beyond, coming to Switch 2 in spring 2027. Kirby gets a big open 3D world, powered-up copy abilities, a Cutter he can ride at high speed, a Bomb that launches him into huge jumps, and a Parasol for gliding. Oh, and King Dedede has kidnapped a mysterious girl, because of course he has.
stories.quip: Dedede never learns, and honestly, we love him for it.

stories.headline: A Lost 1977 Text Adventure Just Crawled Out of the Cave
stories.blurb: Magic Caves, a fantasy text adventure from 1977, is playable on modern hardware for the first time thanks to computer historian Jason Dyer. It was made by physicist John Trenholme, whose laser research helped power fiber-optic internet. You explore treasure-filled caverns with just a lantern, and you can summon a wizard for help, but he charges you 100 points.
stories.quip: Even in 1977, the wizard had a subscription model.

stories.headline: Bluey and Hello Kitty Float Into the 100th Macy's Parade
stories.blurb: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade turns 100 this Thursday, November 26, kicking off at 8:30 a.m. New giant balloons include Bluey, Buckaroo Bob the Minion, Hello Kitty Big Apple, Joe Cool and Woodstock, and Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey, plus mid-size newcomers Underdog and Billie Brightpaw. Get a spot early and bring a thermos.
stories.quip: A century of giant floating cartoons. New York truly invented the best holiday.

stories.headline: Delta Flight Held for a Cat on the Loose. Tower Says Meow.
stories.blurb: Delta flight 2607 from Boston to Tampa paused on the taxiway November 20 because of "a situation in the cabin." The situation was a cat that escaped its kennel. Once kitty was wrangled, the controller signed off with "You have a good day, meow," and the flight still landed on time.
stories.quip: Fasten your seatbelts and also your cats.

stories.headline: The World's Best Cheese Grew Up in Napoleon's Fortress
stories.blurb: A Comté aged 24 months inside Fort des Rousses, a fortress Napoleon founded in the early 1800s, just won the 2026 World Cheese Awards over more than 5,000 cheeses from 40-plus countries. The fort became aging cellars in 1997 and now holds over 100,000 wheels. The final round was a three-way tie, broken by tossing out each cheese's highest and lowest scores.
stories.quip: Napoleon conquered half of Europe. His basement conquered the cheese board.
